# *Roleplay Episode 1: A New Face.*

----------



*You and your family just moved into Mystreet, A Street full of Possibilities and SO Many Things to do here. Your Parents enrolled you to a High School called "Phoenix Drop High", You knew you were in High School already but you missed all your friends from home but at least you have their numbers on your phone.*
*NEXT DAY*
*You walk to school and got ready for your first day. You stepped into school grounds to stumble upon a huge school that looked bigger than your old school. You gazed with awe and amazed by it's huge, Amazing glory as Students alike wore uniforms for both Female and Male and Good thing for you that you also wore a Feminine Uniform otherwise you'd be running home, Just for changing into your uniform. You try to take a selfie with your phone but A Random Male Student {Aaron} pushes by you with a annoyed grunt, You try to confront him but held yourself back and save yourself some trouble. You walk off to class, Looking around you are the lockers and Students that chatted while heading to class. Certain Teachers get ready before Students walk into a classroom that would be filled of choices and Lots of learning to do.*
*{This Is Just the Beginning. You'll have Adventures along your Way During All episodes.}*
*{So... WHAT'S NEXT!!!}*

# *Episode 2: The Neighborhood.*

--------

*After you got off school from your first day. You walk home and see a bunch of your fellow classmates and people from your school at your Neighborhood. You even Notice those Troublemakers: Gene, Sasha and Zenix around.*
*Plus, At School that you did soon develop a Soon-To-Be Crush with Aaron. Even After what he had done to you, you still adore the guy but you notice that you some Competition between you and Michi, Gene's Friend. You and Her have a crush on Aaron but hate each other to where Aaron chose you over Michi. Plus, Your nervous to tell him about you having a crush and Michi wanted to ruin your life but you wanted to prevent that from happening, Which started at school. You walk around your neighborhood for you to go home until you hear some noises behind you..*
*{YOU ENJOY THESE ADVENTURES!!}*
*{WHAT'S NEXT}*

# *Episode 3: School Fight.*
*After a Bunch of Chaos that happened in your Neighborhood, Yesterday that It was time that you had headed to school today.*
*IN THE HIGH SCHOOL*
*You roam around the halls, Greeting the others around you with a shy smile then heard commotion around the corner on where your about to turn.*
*You turn to see a crowd of students gathered around what it looks like a Fight. You ran over to see what was going on and saw Ein and Aaron fighting, AGAIN for the Millionth time but that's not all, The Shadow Knights Gang also known as Gene, Sasha and Zenix were apart of the crowd of students. Gene smirked as always, Sasha just stayed calm as Zenix looked punked up with pride and cry out for Ein to Win the fight as Ein scoffs at Aaron as He spoke: "Now, How about we do it this way? Alaiyah could be mine and you just BACK OFF and Leave us alone!" The way he spoke your name made you shudder with fear. Aaron just grunts of anger and annoyance as He spoke in a tone of Disgust and a hint of Anger: "No, Why do YOU Back off!" He growls and grabs Ein then tosses him down the stairs but Ein was fine and was taken to the Nurses Office. Ein and Aaron both Got Detention after the Fight cleared off as The Crowd of students that were once there for the fight soon spread off to head to their respective classrooms.*

# *Episode 4: Off-Day.*


*Some Weird things have been going on lately. People that you once cared for started to turn on you, Well That was what you thought. First, It was Laurance, Then, Garroth and Finally, Aaron {Aka FC}. You knew one person that only understands you and listens very carefully: FC {A.K.A Aaron}. FC was your Internet friend for a Very, Very Long time. He was the only person that makes you feel comforted and safe to be around, If only if you knew who he was...*
*{Welcome Back!, Enjoy this Adventure!}*
*{So... WHAT's NEXT}*

# *Episode 5: Meeting FC*



*Some Weird things have been going on lately. People that you once cared for started to turn on you, Well That was what you thought. First, It was Laurance, Then, Garroth and Finally, Aaron {Aka FC}. You knew one person that only understands you and listens very carefully: FC. You walk into the room, Where you normally talk to one person that always talk to you in the music room. It was where They would always be there for you to talk to but He started to ignore you to. You started texting FC about things that had been going. You heard some things behind that door. It sounded like Phone rings. FC's text said: "Shu? do you.. Do you hear that?" You texted back and try to figure out what it was. You slowly figure as FC texted: "Shu? Are you behind that Door?" He slowly opens the door and you both gasped. FC was Aaron!...*
*{This is the Last Episode of this Chat. I've had worked so hard on this till I had to get to sleep..}*
*{So, What's Next!}*
